bundle.shortDescription: A living 3D Earth to explore and learn from
bundle.longDescription: Terra Atlas is an educational 3D globe with live earthquakes, natural events, satellites, aurora, aircraft and World Monitor's infrastructure layers, plus guided tours, lessons, a geography quiz and a fluid-dynamics lab.
